newsitem.title: USA: International Multifoods Q3 meets expectations.
newsitem.headline: International Multifoods Q3 meets expectations.

text.p: International Multifoods Corp said Wednesday that its earnings for the third quarter of $0.48 a share, up from $0.38 a year ago, were in line with expectations.

"The company delivered (a) solid performance in its limited-menu distribution, bakery and Venezuela foods businesses, which helped mitigate the ongoing difficulties in vending distribution that led to an operating loss in that business during the quarter," Robert Price, chairman, said in a statement.
Sales for the third quarter ended November 30 were $697.1 million, up 10 percent from $632.1 million a year ago.
Net sales in foodservice distribution were $461.5 million, up from $440.8 million in the third quarter last year. Earnings fell to $4.6 million from $7.9 million a year ago.

Higher volumes and several new customer accounts in the limited-menu distribution business resulted in increased sales in foodservice distribution, the company said. But earnings were hurt because of a loss in vending distribution, which was related to lower volumes, a changing customer mix, competitive pricing pressures and higher costs to improve customer service.

"A new management team is now in place at (the vending operation), and they are moving as quickly as possible to resolve customer service issues and institute rigorous new processes, including better sales and financial management practices," Price said.
The company said these steps will help position vending distribution for improved performance beginning later next year.
Bakery net sales in the third quarter rose 11 percent to $139.7 million from $126.1 million a year ago. Earnings increased to $9.3 million from $8.2 million last year.

Venezuela Foods net sales in the third quarter were $95.9 million, compared with $65.2 million a year ago. Earnings were $5.3 million, up significantly from $426,000 last year, which included a one-time charge of $3.9 million.
The company said the third-quarter performance in the Venezuela Foods segment reflected a relatively stable exchange rate during the quarter, which compared with economic instability of a year ago.
